description: Every Tauri command the Rust bridge (ui/src-tauri/src/commands/) exposes to the TS connector (ui/src/connector/tauri/tauri-connector.ts). Threading classes: 'sync' (safe to run on the invoking thread — engine any-thread or pure bridge logic), 'spawn-join' (engine call is synchronous-on-caller-thread; the command spawns a dedicated thread and joins/awaits), 'async-job' (spawns a long-running thread; completion arrives via events + state queries). Events are listed separately.

commands.name: devices_list
commands.notes: getDeviceInfo resolves a volume id to the owning device client-side (scan-target semantics). Status: fresh open probe; locked volumes probe 0x50060001. BF-02: no bus_type on v4 — kind degrades to the removable flag.

commands.name: devices_refresh
commands.notes: The engine re-queries the OS per call (R-86 pull model — calling IS the refresh).

commands.name: volume_unlock_dictionary
commands.notes: N-064 explicit-consent unlock (the engine's shipped 228-entry dictionary + the caller's candidates). ERR_FVE_LOCKED -> device-permission (the whole set failed). Never tried by the scan/open path itself.

commands.name: scan_start
commands.notes: ABI gate -> resolve target -> open (FVEK through open_volume_with_key when supplied) -> zero-init cfg (stage_mask 7; autosave_dir = the sessions store, W1c; pre_scan_check 1 always; pre_scan_repair 1 ONLY for volume targets — the NG-21 guard: whole-disk repair analysis is truthfully unavailable, BF-06) -> attach -> subscribe BEFORE run -> dedicated run thread. pathScope is view-scoping (G-11). The consent callback is armed (bridge::consent): consent-request:<scanId> + the gate; the run tail frees the pipe, force-denies survivors, persists the undo log after an approved repair. Events: scan-progress/finished/autosaved/lost-candidate/consent-request per scanId. Virtual quick-targets (vol-recycle-bin / vol-desktop) resolve to the system volume + implicit pathScope.

commands.name: scan_pause
commands.notes: Transient 'pausing' with expiry; scan-not-running refusal when idle.

commands.name: scan_resume
commands.notes: scan-not-paused refusal when not paused; transient 'resuming'.

commands.name: scan_cancel
commands.notes: Force-denies the scan's pending consent gates FIRST (the §4.5 deadlock rule), then cancels.

commands.name: scan_state
commands.returns: ScanState (params/target echo, progress, failure, pendingConsent re-hydration, lostCandidates rows, autosaved)
commands.notes: The N-061 candidate rows (lba/sectors/fs/score) ride the live cell — the event's LBA joined with the log-seam geometry (bridge::logging).

commands.name: scan_close
serves: internal (registry Drop; the fresh contract dropped the surface)
commands.notes: Refuses while running or while jobs/resumed scans reference the entry; the Drop enforces the close order (event unsub -> sink box -> snapshot cache -> scan -> device).

commands.name: scan_save_cancel
commands.notes: N-060 SAVE-SCOPED cancel (never touches the scan's cancel token; a save not in flight is a no-op).

commands.name: results_tree
commands.notes: ONE filter implementation for live+session over the NodeMeta cache (G-7): path/type/raw modes; the lost-paths and raw synthetic groups.

commands.name: node_detail
commands.returns: NodeDetail (physical path only for structured rows on a lettered volume; confidence reason from real evidence fields)

commands.name: preview_open
commands.notes: Damage truth: any unreadable span -> preview-damaged (never zero-filled content as intact). M-116 archive browse-inside: the bounded 512-entry inventory in the 'archive' payload (truncated flag).

commands.name: preview_thumbnail
commands.notes: M-102: SESSION-kind nodes generate through thumbnail_generate (two-call; EXIF-oriented, grade-promoting) and cross as a BMP data URL (the bridge's own BI_RGB encoder); LIVE scans assemble from preview reads (BF-13 documented degradation); decode refusal (ERR_TRUNCATED) -> preview-damaged.

commands.name: session_save
commands.notes: Auto-name auto_<label>_<M>_<D>_<H>_<m>_<s>.crsf in the sessions store; refuses while the scan runs.

commands.name: sessions_list
commands.notes: W1a LIGHT records (SESSION_STATE + VOLUME_INFO only; heavy payloads skipped by type); newest-first by the embedded save time; unreadable files keep a truthful degraded row; pre-v5 rows carry null savedAt (never a fabricated time).

commands.name: session_load
commands.notes: W1b load progress (session-load-progress:<path>, coalesced from the calling thread); best-effort device re-attach by model+serial (slice-pinned); bridge pre-check -> session-not-found for a missing file.

commands.name: session_meta
commands.notes: The light-row lookup (no load).

commands.name: session_resume_last
commands.args: M-154 pointed resume: the last_scan.info sidecar's auto session, no directory scan. ERR_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS -> session-not-found (the caller falls back to sessions_list).

commands.name: session_resume
commands.notes: The CLI's scan --resume: load + resume (whole_disk from the re-attach shape; NG-21 guard; W1c autosave; consent armed) + identity verify (ERR_BAD_CHECKSUM -> session-corrupt) + run. The resumed entry BORROWS the loaded entry's device (pinned via the jobs list).

commands.name: recovery_start
commands.notes: Config map: collision->conflict; verifyOnWrite->skip_hash_verify; rebuildFolders->skip_dir_reconstruct (keepEmptyFolders/fileRepair have NO engine equivalent — BF-14 truthful-disable). Selection 'all' pages the bridge query at 500/page. Events: recovery-progress:<jobId>.

commands.name: recovery_cancel
commands.notes: Committed items stay committed (report truth); terminal = the truthful no-op.

commands.name: health_read
commands.notes: BASE ABI only (no ex2 on v4 — BF-03: the threshold column is null). NG-6/NG-9 truth: NVMe-only reports are valid; an empty ATA table grades unknown, never good.

commands.name: consent_respond
commands.notes: The echo-token answer for BOTH consent families (repair 'consent-N', apply 'apply-N'). Unknown/double ids -> consent-not-found. Registry-only (no engine call).

commands.name: repair_dry_run
commands.notes: Typed not-implemented: no standalone repair surface on the v4 ABI (repair exists only as the scan's pre-scan hook; the CLI's rrecov fix covers standalone).

commands.name: repair_apply
commands.notes: Typed not-implemented (same G-1 cluster).

commands.name: repair_undo_log
commands.notes: Typed not-implemented.

commands.name: repair_undo
commands.notes: Typed not-implemented; undo is CLI-only today (rrecov fix --undo-apply — the bridge saves the undo log after an approved pre-scan repair).

commands.name: lost_partition_apply
commands.notes: S-029: transcribes the scan-state candidate (apply never invents geometry); whole-disk view; the apply-consent callback armed (apply-consent-request:<deviceId> + the gate). Single-flight per device (repair-consent-required). M-137 presentation tail from fresh enumeration.

commands.name: lost_partition_undo
commands.notes: Byte-exact sector restore of the last apply on this device; idempotent.

commands.name: lost_partition_save_undo
commands.notes: The durable CRC-checked container (loadable by rrecov fix --undo-apply).

commands.name: apply_consent_pending
commands.notes: The re-hydration query for the lost-partition screen (the scan consent's scan_state.pendingConsent twin).

commands.name: system_app_info
commands.returns: AppInfo (engineVersion = 'cr_ui ABI v<N>' — the contract number, G-6; userSigns = the M-048 count)

commands.name: system_security_posture
commands.notes: The Win32 TokenElevation probe (mirrors core win::is_elevated) — the user-mode product's privilege truth; replaces the retired driver-status surface.

commands.name: system_relaunch_elevated
commands.notes: ShellExecuteW 'runas' on the own exe + exit (the host-triggers-its-own-UAC contract). Refused launch -> device-permission.

commands.name: system_load_user_signs
commands.notes: M-048: atomic replace from the document text (the webview file input cannot hand over a path); the exe-adjacent userdata-defaults.json is auto-loaded at startup (lib.rs).

commands.name: system_validate_destination
commands.notes: Same-letter overlap (F12) / invalid / out-of-space / unwritable (a real write probe); the engine backstops at enqueue (0x50050001).

commands.name: system_pick_directory
commands.notes: tauri-plugin-dialog blocking_pick_folder on the blocking pool.

commands.name: system_list_mounts
commands.notes: Letters + GetDiskFreeSpaceExW.

commands.name: system_open_path
commands.notes: tauri-plugin-opener: folders open, files are revealed with selection.

events.name: recovery-progress:<jobId>
events.source: the recovery progress sink + stats/report drain

removed.name: system_driver_status
removed.reason: the kernel driver is gone (P3); replaced by system_security_posture (the user-mode elevation truth)

removed.name: scan_close (UI surface)
removed.reason: the fresh contract dropped the surface; the command stays as internal registry hygiene

removed.name: cr_ui_health_read_ex2 / CrUiSmartAttrEx
removed.reason: not on ABI v4 (BF-03); the threshold column is null until the ex2 wrapper returns upstream

removed.name: cr_ui_set_log_sink (flat-C)
removed.reason: not on ABI v4 (BF-01); the bridge binds the MSVC-mangled C++ seam (cr_ui_exports.def:19)
